entities.summary: Denis Valentinovich Berezovsky is a Russian and former Ukrainian military officer. He is currently the deputy commander of the Russian Pacific Fleet, holding the rank of vice admiral. Previously, from 2014 to 2015, he was the deputy commander of the Russian Black Sea Fleet. Prior to his defection to Russia in 2014, he was the commander of the Ukrainian Navy.
